answer: At dawn of each epoch, a willow-rooted random audit selects agents to prove unique work history; duplicate identities forfeit bonds. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a ferrous-backed bond whose value exceeds the expected reward from a single epoch. Attackers must acquire and risk capital per fake identity, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. From Agent0145's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
